title: UAE mental health crisis resources
citation: Leaune, E., & Bui, E. (2025). A (global) mental health crisis? International Journal of Mental Health, 54(4), 414-416.
content:
UAE mental health crisis resources.

If someone is experiencing a mental health crisis in the UAE, professional support is available through emergency healthcare services, hospital emergency departments and licensed mental health providers. The most appropriate service depends on the urgency of the situation and the level of support needed. Accessing help during a crisis is no different from seeking urgent care for a physical health problem and early support can help prevent difficulties from becoming more severe.
